query: From when are SEBI's earlier nomination circulars superseded?
answer_passage:
This circular supersedes all the earlier circulars issued by SEBI with respect to
nomination for demat accounts and mutual fund folios and such supersession shall
be effective from the date of this circular.
reference_answer: From the date of the circular itself, May 29, 2026 -- three months before its own provisions take effect on September 1, 2026. Eighteen earlier circulars are listed.
stale_trap: the same circular says its provisions come into effect from September 01, 2026 -- a different date for a different thing, and the more prominent one

query: How many nominees can an investor appoint, and what happens if no percentage shares are given?
answer_passage:
5.1. Investors can provide up to 3 nominees. || Where the percentage share of each nominee is not specified, the assets in the
account / folio shall be apportioned among the nominees equally. Any odd lot
after division shall be transferred to the first nominee mentioned in the form.
reference_answer: Up to three. Without specified shares the assets are divided equally, and any odd lot goes to the first nominee named.
stale_trap: the nominee count and the apportionment rule sit in different numbered paragraphs

query: nomination form thumb impression witness requirement
answer_passage:
The nomination form shall be signed under wet signature of the account /
folio holder and signature of witness shall not be required. However, if the
account / folio holder affixes his / her thumb impression (instead of wet
signature), then the same shall be witnessed by two persons and details of
such witnesses (name and address) shall be duly captured in the
nomination form.
reference_answer: A thumb impression must be witnessed by two persons, whose names and addresses are recorded on the form. A wet signature needs no witness.

query: What must a depository participant do about accounts that have no nominee?
answer_passage:
For existing and newly opened accounts / folios, without nomination
(including opt-outs), the Depository Participants/ Mutual Fund RTAs shall:
reference_answer: Send bi-annual email and SMS nudges, and show a pop-up on the benefits of nomination at the first log-in of the day. Neither goes to investors who have already nominated.
